title: Money
purpose: Sites, workers, staff, and partners are all paid on the same accepted hours, from our own audit. Every payment has a record. Every large payment has two names.
how: One number runs the whole chain. Youssef Medhat's audit sets the accepted hours. KMSC pays the sites, workers, staff, and partners on that audit at month end. Then Adham invoices the client for the same accepted hours. The client pays the US company at net 30, which means 30 days after the invoice, and the US company buys the data from KMSC. KMSC pays everyone about 30 days before the client's money arrives, so the company carries about a month of payouts from its own cash. Nobody is paid for a flagged hour.

Accepted means kept. A reviewer watches every video before the client sees it and marks it keep, flag, or delete. Kept hours are paid. Flagged footage is deleted, never invoiced, and never paid. The wearer log names who made each flagged video. The handbook sets the penalty: 100 EGP per fraudulent video for an operator, 200 EGP for a Portfolio Manager. If the account is banned or the fraud is systemic, it is 250 EGP and 500 EGP. A flag costs the site money, so catch it early.

Ahmed Alaa owns the money: payroll, site and worker payments, partner payments, reimbursements, bonuses and referrals, and the monthly numbers. All money questions go to Ahmed Alaa. Workers ask through their Portfolio Manager. Portfolio Managers and partners ask Ahmed Alaa directly. Every payment is prepared against a record: the wearer log, the QC verdicts, the site or partner agreement, or the offer letter. No record, no payment.

breaks.what: The client rejects hours we invoiced
breaks.do: Only Adham talks to the client. Youssef Medhat matches the rejected sessions against our verdicts the same day. This is the reconcile step. Sites, workers, staff, and partners were already paid on our own audit, so any gap goes to Adham, who owns the client.

breaks.what: A worker says their pay is wrong
breaks.do: Ahmed Alaa handles it and answers within 2 working days. Send the worker's name and role, the month, the amount expected, and the amount received. He checks the wearer log and the verdicts. A disputed flag goes to Youssef Medhat. If he reverses it, the pay is corrected.

breaks.what: A large payment is ready and Adham has not signed
breaks.do: The payment waits. Adham reads the 8:00 PM number every evening, Egypt time, so the wait is hours, not weeks. A late payment can be explained. A wrong payment cannot be taken back.

breaks.what: Someone asks Ahmed Alaa to move money without a record
breaks.do: No. Every payment has a record: who is paid, what for, and which hours or agreement it rests on. He says no once and tells Adham the same day. Pressure on the person who holds the money is a problem for the founders, not for him.

Moharam checks the facts, Ahmed Alaa handles the money, and Adham handles the contract, all the same day. The record is the QC verdicts, the wearer log, and the daily reports. The payment waits while any phone count is open, and a day with no daily report is not paid.

questions.a: At month end, through Ahmed Alaa, on your accepted hours with the flagged hours taken out. Not before the audit.

questions.q: Why is my pay less than my hours?
questions.a: Flags, or a penalty from the handbook table. Ask Ahmed Alaa, with the month, the amount you expected, and the amount you received. If you dispute a flag, Youssef Medhat decides.

questions.q: Can I know what someone else is paid?
questions.a: No. Individual pay is in offer letters. The rules for everyone are on this page.

questions.q: Who sets the threshold, and what is it?
questions.a: Adham sets it, and it is not published. If Ahmed Alaa says a payment needs a second signature, that is the rule working, not a delay.

principle: Sites, workers, staff, and partners are paid on accepted hours, with fraud flags taken out. The company is paid the same way.

approval.rule: Any payment above the approval threshold needs a second signature from Adham before the money moves.
approval.note: Two names go on every large payment. Nobody can ask Ahmed Alaa to move a large sum alone. Nobody can blame him alone.

monthEnd.text: In the last week of the month, a second pass over the whole month's footage. It is finished before any hour is totaled.
